description: Domain-grouped variant of Markov: each intent is grouped under a domain == skill_id (from the 'skill_id:intent' label), and inference first routes the utterance to a domain via DomainMarkovIntentEngine, then resolves the intent inside it by lowest perplexity. Same distribution and confidence gate as markov-medium, registered under a separate opm.pipeline entry point (DomainMarkovPipeline in ovos_markov_pipeline/__init__.py).
model: order-2 word-level Markov chains, Kneser-Ney smoothing with backoff, domain-grouped
notes: Same medium-confidence gate and model parameters as markov-medium; the per-plugin config pins the same n-gram order, smoothing, backoff, stemming, char fallback and confidence thresholds so the comparison isolates domain-first routing. Hypothesis: routing to a domain before scoring perplexity within it should help precision on large multi-domain intent sets (chains from other skills stop competing), and be roughly neutral-to-worse on small single-domain sets where the domain stage adds overhead without payoff.
